## Coral Shine

Coral Shine is a pink-coated, ice-blue-maned background Earth-pony mare from *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic*. She is easiest to recognize as one of Suri Polomare’s models at Manehattan Fashion Week: pale-blue upswept hair, a turquoise bodice, a purple patterned skirt, and matching shoes.

[![Coral Shine modeling in Rarity Takes Manehattan](https://cdn.twibooru.org/img/2020/7/14/647442/medium.png)](https://twibooru.org/647442)

*Image:* Frame from Hasbro Studios/DHX Media’s *Rarity Takes Manehattan*, archived on Twibooru with a television-wiki screenshot as its source; not individually attributed fan art.

**Name and voice.** “Coral Shine” is a **fan-used name**, not one I could verify in on-screen dialogue or official credits. An older screenshot filename calls her “UEM8” (an unnamed-Earth-mare catalog label), not an alternate identity. She has no verified individual speaking lines or voice-actor credit. The [fan-maintained pony index](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Earth_ponies/Mares) identifies her among Suri’s models; the original coiner of the name is unverified.

**Other sightings.** She reappears in *The Gift of the Maud Pie* (S6E3). A fashion-show drawing in [*Simple Ways* (S4E13)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5dfjfCqoeOA) **may** depict her, and the fan index also records her on the Books-A-Million edition cover of IDW’s *Friends Forever* #18. That comic-cover depiction belongs to the comic publication, not a newly established television storyline. No verified disguise, alter ego, or personal backstory.

## Important moments

As a silent background model, she has identifiable *visual appearances*, not documented character-changing decisions or speeches:

- **Suri’s runway presentation — *Rarity Takes Manehattan* (S4E8).** She displays one of Suri’s outfits during the fashion competition that turns Rarity’s generosity into a conflict. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rvByZJTV9uA); **scene timestamp unverified**.
- **Return to Manehattan — *The Gift of the Maud Pie* (S6E3).** She appears again in the city during Rarity and Pinkie Pie’s visit, without an individual speaking role. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FvnhONrbSrA); **scene timestamp unverified**.
